description: This file defines two interfaces related to transaction commit operations within the Orleans framework, specifically in the Transactions Abstractions namespace. It provides abstractions for commit operations and committers parameterized by a service type.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Asynchronous method to commit a transaction given its ID and a service.

methods.name: OnCommit
methods.description: Asynchronous method invoked to perform an action upon commit, accepting a commit operation.
